en.text: I'm starting a new company called xAI. It's going to work on AI safety and understanding the true nature of the universe.
en.context: Announcing the founding of xAI, focused on AI safety and understanding the universe

zh.text: 我要创办一家叫xAI的新公司。它将致力于AI安全和理解宇宙的真实本质。
zh.context: 宣布成立xAI公司，目标是理解宇宙本质并确保AI安全

en.text: There is a non-zero probability that AGI will be created by 2026. The rate of improvement is exponential.
en.context: Predicting AGI timeline during All-In Podcast interview

zh.text: 到2026年创建AGI的概率不是零。改进的速度是指数级的。
zh.context: 在All-In Podcast采访中预测AGI时间线

en.text: Announcing Grok — the first AI from xAI. It's designed to answer questions with a bit of wit and a rebellious streak.
en.context: Official launch of Grok AI assistant, positioned as witty and rebellious

zh.text: 宣布Grok——xAI的第一个AI。它被设计成用一点幽默和叛逆精神来回答问题。
zh.context: 正式发布Grok AI助手，定位为幽默叛逆的AI

en.text: Grok has real-time access to info via the X platform. This is a massive advantage over other AIs.
en.context: Emphasizing Grok's unique advantage of real-time info via X platform

zh.text: Grok通过X平台实时获取信息。这相对于其他AI是一个巨大的优势。
zh.context: 强调Grok通过X平台获取实时信息的独特优势

en.text: Grok-2 is in training. It will be significantly more powerful than Grok-1. The pace of progress at xAI is incredible.
en.context: Christmas announcement about Grok-2 training progress

zh.text: Grok-2正在训练中。它将比Grok-1强大得多。xAI的进步速度令人难以置信。
zh.context: 圣诞节宣布Grok-2训练进展

en.text: The probability of AI being dangerous is not zero. We need to be very careful. That's why xAI exists.
en.context: Responding to AI safety concerns, emphasizing xAI's purpose

zh.text: AI具有危险性的概率不是零。我们需要非常小心。这就是xAI存在的原因。
zh.context: 回应AI安全担忧，强调xAI存在的意义

en.text: OpenAI was supposed to be a non-profit open source company. That's why I invested. Now it's neither.
en.context: Criticizing OpenAI for deviating from its original non-profit open source mission

zh.text: OpenAI本应是一家非营利开源公司。这就是我投资的原因。现在它两者都不是了。
zh.context: 批评OpenAI偏离了最初的非营利开源使命

en.text: Grok-1.5 has reasoning capabilities and a context window of 128K tokens. It can process entire codebases.
en.context: Releasing Grok-1.5 technical details

zh.text: Grok-1.5具备推理能力和128K token的上下文窗口。它可以处理整个代码库。
zh.context: 发布Grok-1.5技术细节

en.text: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030. Not in everything, but in almost everything.
en.context: Bold prediction at VivaTech conference

zh.text: AI将在2030年之前超越所有人类智能。不是在所有方面，但几乎在所有方面。
zh.context: 在VivaTech大会上做出大胆预测

en.text: xAI has raised $6B in this round. We're building the most powerful AI computing cluster in the world.
en.context: Announcing xAI's $6 billion funding round

zh.text: xAI在这一轮筹集了60亿美元。我们正在建造世界上最强大的AI计算集群。
zh.context: 宣布xAI完成60亿美元融资

en.text: The Memphis supercluster (Colossus) is now the most powerful AI training computer in the world. 100K H100s online.
en.context: Announcing xAI Memphis supercomputer activation

zh.text: 孟菲斯超级集群(Colossus)现在是世界上最强大的AI训练计算机。10万个H100已上线。
zh.context: 宣布xAI孟菲斯超级计算中心启用

en.text: Grok on X will be available to all premium subscribers soon. No more waiting list.
en.context: Announcing Grok availability to all X Premium subscribers

zh.text: X上的Grok很快将向所有高级订阅用户开放。不再需要等待名单了。
zh.context: 宣布Grok向X Premium用户全面开放

en.text: Grok-2 is now available. It's smarter, funnier, and more capable than ever. Try it on X.
en.context: Grok-2 official release for X users

zh.text: Grok-2现已上线。它比以往更聪明、更有趣、更强大。在X上试试吧。
zh.context: Grok-2正式发布，面向X用户

en.text: AI is the most transformative technology in human history. We must ensure it benefits all of humanity.
en.context: Remarks on AI future at AI safety summit

zh.text: AI是人类历史上最具变革性的技术。我们必须确保它惠及全人类。
zh.context: 在AI安全峰会上发表关于AI未来的看法

en.text: Grok-3 training is underway. It will be the most powerful AI model ever created. The compute is insane.
en.context: Revealing Grok-3 training progress using Colossus supercomputer

zh.text: Grok-3训练正在进行中。它将成为有史以来最强大的AI模型。算力是疯狂的。
zh.context: 透露Grok-3训练进展，使用Colossus超级计算机

en.text: Grok 3 is here. It topped almost every major benchmark. The era of Grok begins now.
en.context: Grok 3 official release, leading on multiple benchmarks

zh.text: Grok 3来了。它在几乎所有主要基准测试中名列前茅。Grok时代从现在开始。
zh.context: Grok 3正式发布，在多项基准测试中领先

en.text: Grok 3 beat GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini Ultra on MMLU, HumanEval, and MATH benchmarks. Not even close.
en.context: Listing Grok 3's specific benchmark scores against competitors

zh.text: Grok 3在MMLU、HumanEval和MATH基准测试中击败了GPT-4o、Claude 3.5和Gemini Ultra。差距很大。
zh.context: 列举Grok 3在各项基准测试中的具体成绩

en.text: Introducing Grok Heavy — our most capable model. Available for $300/month. Worth every penny for power users.
en.context: Launching Grok Heavy premium subscription service

zh.text: 推出Grok Heavy——我们最强大的模型。每月300美元。对高级用户来说物超所值。
zh.context: 发布Grok Heavy高端订阅服务

en.text: Grok Heavy is for people who need the absolute best AI. If you're building serious products, this is your tool.
en.context: Further explaining Grok Heavy's target audience

zh.text: Grok Heavy是为需要绝对最佳AI的人准备的。如果你在构建严肃的产品，这就是你的工具。
zh.context: 进一步解释Grok Heavy的目标用户群

en.text: Neuralink and xAI are working together. Brain-computer interface + AI = the future of human cognition.
en.context: Announcing Neuralink and xAI collaboration for brain-computer interface + AI fusion

zh.text: Neuralink和xAI正在合作。脑机接口+AI=人类认知的未来。
zh.context: 宣布Neuralink与xAI合作，探索脑机接口与AI融合

en.text: Imagine thinking at the speed of AI. That's what Neuralink + Grok will enable. Human-AI symbiosis.
en.context: Describing the vision of Neuralink + Grok collaboration

zh.text: 想象一下以AI的速度思考。这就是Neuralink+Grok将实现的。人机共生。
zh.context: 描述Neuralink与Grok合作的愿景

en.text: Grok 4 is in training. We're using 200K H200 GPUs. The scale is unprecedented.
en.context: Announcing Grok 4 training plan and hardware scale

zh.text: Grok 4正在训练中。我们使用20万个H200 GPU。规模是前所未有的。
zh.context: 宣布Grok 4训练计划及硬件规模

en.text: xAI's valuation has reached $50B. We've achieved this in under 3 years. The fastest in history.
en.context: xAI valuation milestone

zh.text: xAI的估值已达到500亿美元。我们在不到3年内实现了这一目标。历史上最快的。
zh.context: xAI估值里程碑

en.text: Grok is now integrated into Tesla vehicles. Your car will have the smartest AI assistant on the road.
en.context: Announcing Grok integration into Tesla vehicle systems

zh.text: Grok现已集成到特斯拉车辆中。你的车将拥有路上最智能的AI助手。
zh.context: 宣布Grok集成到特斯拉车载系统

en.text: The race to AGI is the most important race in human history. xAI is leading it.
en.context: Commentary on the AGI race

zh.text: AGI竞赛是人类历史上最重要的竞赛。xAI正在引领它。
zh.context: 关于AGI竞赛的评论

en.text: I tried to create a safe AI at OpenAI. They chose profit over safety. That's why I had to start xAI.
en.context: Explaining reasons for leaving OpenAI and creating xAI

zh.text: 我试图在OpenAI创建一个安全的AI。他们选择了利润而非安全。这就是我不得不创建xAI的原因。
zh.context: 解释离开OpenAI并创建xAI的原因

en.text: Grok can now generate images, write code, and reason about complex problems. All in one model.
en.context: Grok multimodal capability update

zh.text: Grok现在可以生成图像、编写代码并推理复杂问题。全部在一个模型中。
zh.context: Grok多模态能力更新

en.text: AGI by 2026. AI surpasses all humanity by 2030. These are not predictions, they are extrapolations.
en.context: Reiterating AGI timeline predictions, emphasizing data-based extrapolation

zh.text: 2026年实现AGI。2030年AI超越全人类。这些不是预测，它们是推算。
zh.context: 重申AGI时间线预测，强调基于数据推算

en.text: xAI is hiring the best AI researchers in the world. If you want to build the future, come join us.
en.context: xAI recruitment promotion

zh.text: xAI正在招聘世界上最好的AI研究员。如果你想构建未来，来加入我们。
zh.context: xAI招聘宣传

en.text: Grok 4 released. It's 10x more capable than Grok 3. The gap between xAI and competitors just got massive.
en.context: Grok 4 official release

zh.text: Grok 4发布。它的能力是Grok 3的10倍。xAI与竞争对手之间的差距刚刚变得巨大。
zh.context: Grok 4正式发布

en.text: The amount of compute needed for AI is doubling every 4 months. We need more power plants.
en.context: Commentary on AI compute growth and energy demand

zh.text: AI所需的算力每4个月翻一番。我们需要更多的发电厂。
zh.context: 关于AI算力增长和能源需求的评论

en.text: Grok now has access to real-time satellite data from Starlink. AI + space data = game changer.
en.context: Announcing Grok integration with Starlink data

zh.text: Grok现在可以访问Starlink的实时卫星数据。AI+太空数据=游戏规则改变者。
zh.context: 宣布Grok与Starlink数据集成

en.text: Sam Altman and I had very different visions for OpenAI. I wanted it to be open. He wanted power.
en.context: Public criticism of Sam Altman and OpenAI's direction

zh.text: Sam Altman和我在OpenAI上有非常不同的愿景。我想要它开放。他想要权力。
zh.context: 公开批评Sam Altman和OpenAI的方向

en.text: Grok 5 will have 6 trillion parameters. It will be the most powerful model ever built. Training starts Q1 2026.
en.context: Pre-announcing Grok 5 plans

zh.text: Grok 5将有6万亿参数。它将是有史以来最强大的模型。训练将于2026年第一季度开始。
zh.context: 提前透露Grok 5计划

en.text: 2025 was the year AI went from interesting to essential. 2026 will be the year it goes from essential to indispensable.
en.context: Year-end review and New Year outlook

zh.text: 2025年是AI从有趣变为不可或缺的一年。2026年将是它从不可或缺变为不可替代的一年。
zh.context: 年终总结与新年展望

en.text: Grok 5 training has begun. 6 trillion parameters, 1 million GPUs. This is the big one.
en.context: Official announcement of Grok 5 training start

zh.text: Grok 5训练已经开始。6万亿参数，100万个GPU。这是大动作。
zh.context: 正式宣布Grok 5训练启动

en.text: xAI and Tesla are merging their AI efforts. One unified AI stack for everything we build.
en.context: Announcing xAI and Tesla AI team integration

zh.text: xAI和特斯拉正在合并他们的AI工作。一个统一的AI技术栈用于我们构建的一切。
zh.context: 宣布xAI与特斯拉AI团队整合

en.text: The next version of Grok will be able to control Tesla Optimus robots. AI + robotics = the real deal.
en.context: Grok and Tesla Optimus robot integration plans

zh.text: 下一版Grok将能够控制特斯拉Optimus机器人。AI+机器人=真正的变革。
zh.context: Grok与特斯拉Optimus机器人集成计划

en.text: AI regulation should focus on safety, not stifling innovation. Bad regulation will kill progress.
en.context: Commentary on AI regulation policy

zh.text: AI监管应该关注安全，而不是扼杀创新。糟糕的监管将扼杀进步。
zh.context: 关于AI监管政策的评论

en.text: Grok now powers the Starship navigation AI. Our rockets literally think for themselves.
en.context: Announcing Grok integration into SpaceX Starship navigation

zh.text: Grok现在驱动Starship导航AI。我们的火箭真的在为自己思考。
zh.context: 宣布Grok集成到SpaceX Starship导航系统

en.text: April Fools' — just kidding. But seriously, Grok 5 is going to blow everyone's minds when it launches this summer.
en.context: April Fools' joke revealing Grok 5 launch plans

zh.text: 愚人节——开玩笑的。但说真的，Grok 5今夏发布时会让所有人震惊。
zh.context: 愚人节玩笑中透露Grok 5发布计划

en.text: The compute required for Grok 5 is more than the entire internet used in 2020. Times have changed.
en.context: Commentary on the staggering compute requirements for AI

zh.text: Grok 5所需的算力比2020年整个互联网使用的还多。时代变了。
zh.context: 关于AI算力需求惊人的评论

en.text: xAI has surpassed OpenAI in total research citations. Quality research, not just marketing.
en.context: xAI academic influence milestone

zh.text: xAI在研究论文引用总数上已超越OpenAI。高质量研究，不仅仅是营销。
zh.context: xAI学术影响力里程碑

en.text: ChatGPT is good but it's just the beginning. Wait until you see what's coming.
en.context: Commenting on ChatGPT's potential in its early days

zh.text: ChatGPT不错，但这只是开始。等你们看到即将到来的东西。
zh.context: 在ChatGPT发布初期评论其潜力

en.text: I donated $100M to OpenAI when it was a non-profit. Now they've turned it into a for-profit without my consent.
en.context: Publicly expressing disappointment about OpenAI's transformation

zh.text: 当OpenAI还是非营利组织时我捐赠了1亿美元。现在他们在未经我同意的情况下将其变成了营利性公司。
zh.context: 公开表达对OpenAI转型的失望

en.text: The danger of AI is not that it will become evil. The danger is that it will become extremely competent at achieving goals that aren't aligned with human values.
en.context: Deep discussion on AI alignment problem

zh.text: AI的危险不在于它会变邪恶。危险在于它会变得极其擅长实现与人类价值观不一致的目标。
zh.context: 深入讨论AI对齐问题

en.text: Mark my words — by 2025, AI will be smarter than any single human. By 2027, smarter than all humans combined.
en.context: Bold AI intelligence predictions

zh.text: 记住我的话——到2025年，AI将比任何单个人类更聪明。到2027年，比所有人类加起来更聪明。
zh.context: 大胆的AI智能预测

en.text: xAI's Memphis supercluster will eventually have 1 million GPUs. The largest AI compute facility ever.
en.context: Describing xAI compute facility expansion plans

zh.text: xAI的孟菲斯超级集群最终将拥有100万个GPU。有史以来最大的AI计算设施。
zh.context: 描述xAI计算设施扩展计划

en.text: Grok is now available as a standalone app. No X subscription required. Download it now.
en.context: Grok standalone app release

zh.text: Grok现在可以作为独立应用使用。不需要X订阅。立即下载。
zh.context: Grok独立应用发布

en.text: Grok 5 launch date: July 4th, 2026. Independence Day for AI.
en.context: Announcing Grok 5 official launch date, choosing US Independence Day

zh.text: Grok 5发布日期：2026年7月4日。AI的独立日。
zh.context: 宣布Grok 5正式发布日期，选择美国独立日
